title: Pullback map on etale cohomology
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with small etale sites $X_{\Et}$, $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $u_*$ be the direct image, $(u_*F)(W)=F(W\times_XY)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], so that $\Gamma(X,u_*F)=(u_*F)(X)=F(Y)=\Gamma(Y,F)$ for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $Y_{\Et}$, where $\Gamma(T,-)$ is evaluation at the final object $T$ of $T_{\Et}$; let $u^{-1}$ be the inverse image, with unit $\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$ of the adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Choose a K-injective resolution $G\to I^\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] (one exists; a resolution by a bounded below complex of injective abelian sheaves is one [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist]) and a K-injective resolution $u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ of the termwise inverse image on $Y_{\Et}$. Since $u^{-1}$ is exact [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact], it commutes with taking cohomology of complexes, so $u^{-1}G\to u^{-1}I^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism and the composite $u^{-1}G\to u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ is a K-injective resolution of $u^{-1}G$. The *pullback map*

$$
 u^*:H^q(X_{\Et},G)\longrightarrow H^q(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)\qquad(q\ge0)
$$

between the cohomology groups of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] (computed there as $\mathcal H^q(\Gamma(X,I^\bullet))$ and $\mathcal H^q(\Gamma(Y,J^\bullet))$, from the K-injective resolutions $I^\bullet$ and $J^\bullet$) is the map induced in degree $q$ by the morphism of complexes of abelian groups

$$
 \Gamma(X,I^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\ \Gamma(X,\eta_{u,I^\bullet})\ }\Gamma(X,u_*u^{-1}I^\bullet)=\Gamma(Y,u^{-1}I^\bullet)\longrightarrow\Gamma(Y,J^\bullet),
$$

that is, a section $a\in I^r(X)$ goes to the image of $\eta_{u,I^r}(a)\in(u^{-1}I^r)(Y)$ in $J^r(Y)$ ("pull back the section, then compare with the resolution"). For $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], represented by a bounded below complex $K^\bullet$, the same recipe, with $K^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ a K-injective resolution, $u^{-1}K^\bullet$ the termwise inverse image representing $u^{-1}K$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and $u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ a K-injective resolution, gives a morphism of complexes $\Gamma(X,I^\bullet)\to\Gamma(Y,J^\bullet)$ whose class in $\Dplus(\Ab)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is $u^*:\RGamma(X_{\Et},K)\to\RGamma(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}K)$, with $\RGamma$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. The definition depends on the chosen resolutions; that the induced maps do not (after the identifications of [prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent]), and the naturality, composition and etale-restriction properties of $u^*$, are the statement lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial, which is about this definition and is therefore cited here by name only. That $u^*$ is also $\RGamma(X,-)$ of the unit $\eta^D_u:K\to Ru_*u^{-1}K$ of the derived adjunction followed by $\RGamma(X,Ru_*-)=\RGamma(Y,-)$ is the statement lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit, likewise cited by name only.

source.place: Section Tag 01F7 (section-functoriality): Lemma Tag 01F8 (lemma-functoriality), applied to the bounded below complexes $\mathcal G^\bullet=I^\bullet$ and $\mathcal F^\bullet=u^{-1}I^\bullet$ and the morphism $\varphi=\eta_{u,I^\bullet}:I^\bullet\to u_*u^{-1}I^\bullet$, whose proof represents $I^\bullet\to Ru_*u^{-1}I^\bullet$ by $I^\bullet\to u_*u^{-1}I^\bullet\to u_*J^\bullet$; equations Tag 01F9 (equation-functorial-derived) and Tag 01FA (equation-functorial) then apply $R\Gamma(X,-)$, which on the K-injective $I^\bullet$ and $u_*J^\bullet$ is $\Gamma(X,-)$, with $\Gamma(X,u_*J^\bullet)=\Gamma(Y,J^\bullet)$; Remark Tag 01FB (remark-explain-arrow) gives the same arrow through resolutions on the target side. Written in Stacks for ringed spaces; the small etale site is the same construction with the etale direct and inverse images (literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex Remark Tag 08J6, remark-before-Leray; literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex Section Tag 04I0, section-functoriality, and Definition Tag 03PY, definition-direct-image-sheaf)

split_report.summary: Checked the definition against Stacks cohomology.tex 01F7/01F8/01F9/01FA/01FB. The recipe of the node (pull back a K-injective resolution I of G, resolve u^{-1}I by J, take Gamma(X,I) -> Gamma(Y,u^{-1}I) -> Gamma(Y,J)) is Lemma 01F8 applied to phi = eta_{u,I}: I -> u_*u^{-1}I followed by RGamma(X,-) and Gamma(X,u_*J) = Gamma(Y,J) as in 01F9; Remark 01FB is the equivalent recipe with resolutions on X, equal by lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial. Statement dependencies: 'morphism of schemes' repointed from the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions to def-pc-scheme; abelian sheaves from def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves (torsion/constructible grab-bag) to the Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves; added def-weil-pbc-etale-site, prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist (existence of the resolutions; bounded below injective complexes are K-injective), def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image (u^{-1}K on D^+), def-weil-abstract-derived-category (D^+(Ab)) and prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent (the identification under which independence is stated). Claims inside: the composite u^{-1}G -> u^{-1}I -> J is a K-injective resolution by exactness of u^{-1} [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact] (an exact functor commutes with cohomology of complexes, one line); Gamma(X,u_*F) = F(Y) is the definition of u_* at W = X; independence of choices and the etale case are lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial, cited by name only (its stmt_deps contain this definition, so a dependency would be a cycle; it stays in pointers); the etale sentence 'u^{-1}G = G|_Y and u^* is restriction' was moved out of the definition into that citation, being its item 5. The alternative description through the unit of u^{-1} -/ Ru_* and RGamma(X,Ru_*-) = RGamma(Y,-) is the new unsplit statement lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit (cited by name in the text only, since its stmt_deps contain this definition; pointers left as they were, as the brief asks; the new node is flagged unreachable). Alignment: def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology defines H^q(T,F) as H^q(Gamma(T,I)) for a K-injective resolution I and RGamma(T,K) as Gamma of a K-injective resolution, i.e. through K-injective resolutions, not through an abstract RGamma; this definition uses the same resolutions, so the groups are literally those of that node. Mathlib: Sheaf.H is Ext from the constant sheaf and Sheaf.H.map is functorial in the sheaf on one site only; no map along a morphism of sites (three kinds of search recorded); not a leaf. Source repository: AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.cohomologyMap (slopmaster2, WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/UpperLowerStar/TopologicalInvariance.lean:178-186, sorry-free) is the Ext-definition (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor of f^* with Z_X = f^*Z_Y); its agreement with this resolution definition is a theorem, so it is not attached.
